WITH linked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.abhvreg,
    ab.translink,
    tr.transreg,
    tr.trdref,
    trd.tradereg,
    trd.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader trd ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
),
trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as trans_count
  FROM linked_data
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    trans_count,
    CAST(trans_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(trans_count) FROM trader_type_counts) as share
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  ws.tradekind,
  ws.trans_count,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - avg.avg_share as diff
FROM with_shares ws, avg_share avg
WHERE ws.share > avg.avg_share
  AND avg.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ws.share DESC;
